ShippingPage.intro: We ship from Guatemala by international courier. The cost depends on the country and the box size, and you can see it on each mask's page before buying.
ShippingPage.otherCountries: Don't see your country? Message us and we'll quote it.
ShippingPage.timesBody: We use FedEx International Economy and International Priority (faster). Exact timing depends on the destination; we confirm it when we ship, with a tracking number.
ShippingPage.costBody: Shipping a single mask by express courier can cost more than the mask. If you buy 2 or 3, they go in the same box and shipping per piece drops a lot.
ShippingPage.dutiesBody: Import duties and taxes are paid by the recipient on delivery. The United States suspended the small-purchase (de minimis) exemption and currently charges an extra tariff on goods from Guatemala; these rules change often.
ShippingPage.packagingBody: Each mask is wrapped in bubble wrap inside a rigid box, with an SC Art Studio card.
ShippingPage.damageBody: Take photos of the box and the mask when you open it and message us on WhatsApp or by email. We'll review every case with you.

About.title: About Scarlett
About.intro: Scarlett is an 11-year-old artist from Guatemala. She hand-paints every SC Art Studio mask. Flip through her book to meet her.
About.hint: Use the arrows, your keyboard or swipe to turn the pages.
About.privacy: An adult in the family runs the shop and answers every message.
About.coverTagline: Masks with a wild animal soul
About.welcomeBadge: Handmade · painted with lots of color
About.welcomeHeading: Masks with a wild animal soul
About.welcomeBody: I'm Scarlett, I'm 11, and I paint every mask with my own hands. Each one has its own personality, its own spots and a little sparkle on its forehead.
About.meBody1: I love painting, and my masks are my favorite way to tell stories with color.
About.meBody2: I like wolves, dinosaurs and books. That's why my masks are animals full of strength and imagination.
About.factBooksLabel: reading gives me ideas to paint
About.masksBody: Every mask is unique: no two are alike.
About.jaguar: Bright orange, black spots and a turquoise crystal on its forehead.
About.lobo: White, with purple flowers and green and light-blue horns.
About.venado: A thousand shades of pink, white spots and striped antlers.
About.cebra: Pink and orange stripes, turquoise dots and a fuchsia crystal.
About.how1Body: Browse the catalog and choose the mask you like best.
About.how2Body: Pay in the shop and we'll let you know when it ships.
About.how3Body: We pack it with care and it arrives by courier.
About.contactBody: Message us or order a custom mask. An adult in the family answers the messages.
About.backBody: Every mask is unique: no two are alike.

CustomPage.intro: Got a favorite animal or a wild idea? Scarlett can make a mask just for you, from cardboard and paper, painted by hand.

tell.title: Tell us your idea
tell.body: Fill in the form with the animal, the colors and, if you like, a reference photo.

talk.title: We reply
talk.body: Within 24 to 48 hours we write to you on WhatsApp or by email with price and timing.

make.title: Scarlett makes it
make.body: Once you agree, your mask is started and we send you progress photos.
